WITH target_campaign AS (
    SELECT c.id
    FROM campaigns c
    WHERE c.id = $1::UUID

      -- Initial generation should only start from these states.
      AND c.status IN (
          'brief_received',
          'automation_error'
      )

      -- Do not create another initial version if one already exists.
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM campaign_versions cv
          WHERE cv.campaign_id = c.id
      )
),

updated_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns c
    SET status = 'generating'
    FROM target_campaign target
    WHERE c.id = target.id

    RETURNING
        c.id,
        c.campaign_code,
        c.client_id,
        c.product_service,
        c.target_audience,
        c.offer,
        c.objective,
        c.brand_tone,
        c.brief,
        c.status,
        c.created_at,
        c.updated_at
)

SELECT
    updated_campaign.id::TEXT AS campaign_id,
    updated_campaign.campaign_code,
    updated_campaign.product_service,
    updated_campaign.target_audience,
    updated_campaign.offer,
    updated_campaign.objective,
    updated_campaign.brand_tone,
    updated_campaign.brief,
    updated_campaign.status,
    updated_campaign.created_at,
    updated_campaign.updated_at,

    clients.id::TEXT AS client_id,
    clients.client_code,
    clients.name AS client_name,
    clients.company_name,
    clients.email AS client_email,
    clients.website

FROM updated_campaign

JOIN clients
    ON clients.id = updated_campaign.client_id;

WITH input_data AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),

save_version AS (
    INSERT INTO campaign_versions (
        campaign_id,
        version_number,
        generation_type,
        model_name,
        prompt_version,
        content,
        validation_status,
        validation_errors
    )

    SELECT
        (data->>'campaign_id')::UUID,
        (data->>'version_number')::INTEGER,
        data->>'generation_type',
        data->>'model_name',
        data->>'prompt_version',
        data->'content',
        'passed',
        '[]'::JSONB

    FROM input_data

    ON CONFLICT (
        campaign_id,
        version_number
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        generation_type =
            EXCLUDED.generation_type,

        model_name =
            EXCLUDED.model_name,

        prompt_version =
            EXCLUDED.prompt_version,

        content =
            EXCLUDED.content,

        validation_status =
            'passed',

        validation_errors =
            '[]'::JSONB

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_id,
        version_number,
        generation_type,
        model_name,
        prompt_version,
        validation_status,
        created_at
),

update_campaign AS (
    UPDATE campaigns
    SET status = 'awaiting_approval'

    WHERE id = (
        SELECT campaign_id
        FROM save_version
    )

    RETURNING
        id,
        campaign_code,
        status,
        updated_at
),

write_log AS (
    INSERT INTO automation_logs (
        workflow_name,
        campaign_id,
        level,
        event_type,
        message,
        details
    )

    SELECT
        '03 - Generate AI Campaign Package',

        save_version.campaign_id,

        'info',

        'ai_campaign_version_created',

        'Initial AI campaign package generated and validated successfully.',

        jsonb_build_object(
            'campaign_code',
                input_data.data->>'campaign_code',

            'version_number',
                save_version.version_number,

            'model_name',
                save_version.model_name,

            'prompt_version',
                save_version.prompt_version,

            'interaction_id',
                input_data.data->>'interaction_id',

            'usage',
                COALESCE(
                    input_data.data->'usage',
                    '{}'::JSONB
                )
        )

    FROM save_version
    CROSS JOIN input_data

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    save_version.id::TEXT
        AS campaign_version_id,

    save_version.campaign_id::TEXT
        AS campaign_id,

    update_campaign.campaign_code,

    save_version.version_number,

    save_version.generation_type,

    save_version.model_name,

    save_version.prompt_version,

    save_version.validation_status,

    update_campaign.status
        AS campaign_status,

    save_version.created_at,

    update_campaign.updated_at

FROM save_version

JOIN update_campaign
    ON update_campaign.id =
       save_version.campaign_id;

versionMetadata.name: v1.0 — AI Campaign Generation Release
versionMetadata.description: Loads a saved campaign brief, generates a structured advertising package with Gemini, validates the AI output, stores Version 1, and starts the approval process.
